Title: Historia de la provincia de Philipinas de la Compañia de Jesus, segunda parte, que comprehende los progresos de esta provincia desde el año de 1616 hasta el de 1716
Creator: Pedro Murillo Velarde, S.J., chronicler of the province
Publisher: Manila: en la Imprenta de la Compañía de Jesús, por D. Nicolás de la Cruz Bagay, 1749
Publication Date: 1749
Rights: Public Domain (published 1749, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: spa
Source: Internet Archive item historiadelaprov00muri (https://archive.org/details/historiadelaprov00muri), the item's own historiadelaprov00muri_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: John Carter Brown Library; host metadata date: 1749. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 6e1136af525577c6402c6197439455b7ed2c990bc93ee97fc1b1f704e6cfd3c4.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. John Carter Brown Library scan; clean OCR for its age with the long s read as f; the folding map of the islands comes first and OCRs as scattered place names.
Content note: The Jesuit province's own history from 1616 to 1716, printed at the Jesuit press in Manila: the missions in Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao, the colleges, the Jesuits among the Moros, the province's quarrels with archbishops and governors, and the lives and deaths of its members.
